d:
Priy vyuar,
Hamare sanvidhan ke jin anuchchhedon par sarvadhik vivad hota raha hai, unmen anuchchhed 44 agrani mahattv ka hai jo rajy ko saman nagrik sanhita (Uniform Civil Code) ke nirman hetu prayas karne ka nirdesh deta hai. aajkal saman nagrik sanhita ka mudda phir charcha men hai kyonki anuman lagaya ja raha hai ki anuchchhed-370 tatha ram mandir mudde ke bad ab kendr sarkar apne isi antim vayde par dhyan kendrit karne vali hai.
